simplification_selection: largest epsilon with dev p95 max-polyline-deviation <= 0.004, p95 absolute length drift <= 0.02 and p95 terminal-angle difference <= 5 degrees versus B; otherwise epsilon 0
candidate_hard_filters: exact canonical, variant, role, parent layout, stroke count
candidate_ranking: standard geometry shape + log aspect mismatch + training confidence; deterministic tie break, never target handwriting
target_layout: bounding box of selected component in frozen training-only A output; same for B,C and matched compressed control
main_paths: B whole raw exemplar similarity transform
C feature-protected bounded simplification then identical transform
additional_controls: M same exemplar 16->8->B-spline under identical B transform
B_xy C_xy M_xy bounded anisotropic sensitivity separate from similarity
evaluation: same glyph self-reconstruction separate from cross-character target holdout; per-character paired summaries; no inferential p-values from single writer
geometry_metrics: terminal direction over common reference arc window
feature-defined terminal hook length with detection coverage
strict transverse intersections separate from endpoint touches
generation_invariants: global monotonic time reassigned in output order
